verdict.rationale: The evidence only briefly references 'Pulumi Registry providers' in the context of language support (pulumi-docs-1/22), but there is no documentation in the pack describing a public registry workflow for developers to publish their own reusable modules/components (e.g., Pulumi Packages, Component Resources publishing) nor a clear consume-from-registry story beyond first-party providers. Missing for 10: explicit registry publish workflow docs, package/component authoring & publishing guide, and any consumption example of third-party community modules.
